Name.title: String update value
Name.description: The name of the block (or `null` if the name should not be updated).

FirstTimeUnitStartUtc.title: String update value
FirstTimeUnitStartUtc.description: Start of the time interval, expressed as the timestamp for the start of the first time unit, in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format (or `null` if the start time should not be updated).

LastTimeUnitStartUtc.title: String update value
LastTimeUnitStartUtc.description: End of the time interval, expressed as the timestamp for the start of the last time unit, in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format (or `null` if the end time should not be updated).

ExternalIdentifier.title: String update value
ExternalIdentifier.description: Identifier of the block from external system (or `null` if the identifier should not be updated).

State.title: String update value
State.description: State of the availability block (or `null` if not updated).

ReservationPurpose.title: String update value
ReservationPurpose.description: The purpose of the block (or `null` if not updated).

CompanyId.title: Guid update value
CompanyId.description: Unique identifier of the [Company](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/companies#company) (or `null` if not updated).

TravelAgencyId.title: Guid update value
TravelAgencyId.description: Unique identifier of the travel agency (i.e. `Company`; or `null` if not updated).

BookerId.title: Guid update value
BookerId.description: Unique identifier of the Booker as a creator of an availability block (or `null` if not updated).

Notes.title: String update value
Notes.description: Additional notes of the block (or `null` if not updated).

Budget.title: Currency value (ver 2018-06-07) update value
Budget.description: The tentative budget for the total price of reservations (or `null` if not updated).

CancellationReason.title: String update value
CancellationReason.description: Cancellation reason of the availability block (or `null` if not updated).

CancellationReasonDetail.title: String update value
CancellationReasonDetail.description: Cancellation reason detail of the availability block (or `null` if not updated).

RollingReleaseOffset.title: String update value
RollingReleaseOffset.description: Exact offset from the start of availability adjustments to the moment the availability adjustment should be released, in ISO 8601 duration format. Required if `ReleaseStrategy` is set to `RollingRelease`, ignored otherwise.

ReleasedUtc.title: String update value
ReleasedUtc.description: The moment when the block and its availability is released, in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format. Required if `ReleaseStrategy` is set to `FixedRelease`, or used when `ReleaseStrategy` update is unspecified.

ReleaseStrategy.title: Release strategy update value
ReleaseStrategy.description: The strategy for automatic release of the availability block (or `null` if not updated).

QuoteId.title: Guid update value
QuoteId.description: Unique identifier of the Mews Events quote associated with the availability block (or `null` if not updated).

PurchaseOrderNumber.title: String update value
PurchaseOrderNumber.description: Unique number of the purchase order. This number is propagated to any newly picked up `Reservation` within the block.

BusinessSegmentId.title: Guid update value
BusinessSegmentId.description: Unique identifier of the Business segment.
